title: The path
hints: You need to write four instructions on four lines.
First move down twice, then right twice.
intro: The gate will not open yet, so let us look around the meadow! We can walk down the path a little, then turn right into the grass.
outro: Well done! You can use methods to move anywhere. Let us see what else we can find out here.
learned: Now you know what objects and methods are, and how to use the four moves.
